{{Quote|They savaged the outpost at Furies Gate, then took the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr and their moons&mdash;before we blunted their attack on Tython itself.|Log of Je'daii Master Daegen|<ref name="Force War 1 />}}
Around [[25,792 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] '''captured''' the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Obri]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]] from the [[Settled Worlds]] of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The battle followed an [[Attack on Fury Station|attack]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Fury Station]]. From there, the Infinite Empire [[First battle of Tython|struck]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. [[Je'daii Master]] [[Daegen Lok]] recorded the capture of Obri as well as other events of the invasion in a log.<ref name="Force War 1 />

==Behind the scenes==
The capture of Obri was mentioned in [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War|Force War]] miniseries, a story arc in the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The series was written by [[John Ostrander]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Force War 1 /> on November 23, 2013.<ref name="Dark Horse Release">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/22-793/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-Force-War-1|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—Force War #1}}</ref>
